Landed as Gerrit change 3112 (commit 6825490b649; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved, no advisories). make verify before the push: 17 failed, 19747 passed; all 17 failures are the known pandoc set under tests/unit/reconciler, none elsewhere, 0 ERROR lines.

Evidence on merged main (HEAD fedf819b2d2), 2026-10-25 14:36 PDT:
1. git grep -n -E 'editor_assets|prompt_authoring|node_modules|"e2e:' -- pyproject.toml printed nothing (exit 1).
2. uv build --wheel built nava_rebar-0.13.1; unzip -l on the wheel shows 972 files and 'grep -c editor_assets' prints 0.
3. The change's CI run 40233812952 shows the pip-audit job (dependency vulnerabilities) green. The lock still carries oauthlib 3.3.1 (PYSEC-2026-4114, fixed only in 4.0.0, transitive); the gate warns on it and does not fail.

What changed: removed the editor bundle glob from the wheel artifacts, the node_modules entries from the wheel and sdist excludes, the unused e2e pytest marker (no test uses it; strict markers are on), and reworded the BLE001 comment that still named the deleted prompt_authoring module. Nothing outside pyproject.toml changed.
